svg.title: DEADMAN detailed architecture
svg.desc: A detailed view of the DEADMAN engine: a monitor posts an alert to the /alerts webhook, which normalises and de-duplicates it onto a durable BullMQ/Redis queue; a worker opens a TrueForge session so the harness calls read and write tools over MCP; read tools are narrated by Claude and read the cluster; write tools flow through a blast-radius classifier to an approval gate and a sensitive-target guard before acting on the cluster, with safe actions auto-running and hardline actions refused; an auto-rollback watchdog watches the cluster health and reverts fixes that do not hold; and every action is written to an append-only audit trail and streamed over SSE to the React cockpit.
